question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Lethal
solution:
The correct answer is- **"Deadly" **(घातक, जानलेवा).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given options,** "Deadly"** is the most appropriate synonym of** "Lethal".**
 
• **Lethal: **It refers to something that is death causing or fatal (मृत्‍युकारक, घातक).
 
 
• **Example: **Inhalation of this toxic gas is **lethal** for human beings.
 
 
 
• Thus, ***option 4)*** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Let us understand the meaning of other options too.

 
• **Drowsy: **having unusually high levels of daytime fatigue or sleepiness (निद्रालु)

 
 
• **Example: **The child felt so worm in her mother's lap that he got **drowsy**.
 
 
 
• **Noisy: **making a lot of noise (शोर मचाने वाला)
 
 
• **Example: **The children playing in the park are so **noisy** that they disturb my sleep.
 
 
 
• **Slimy: **Denotes either dishonesty and rudeness or something sticky and wet (चिपचिपा, अविश्‍वसनीय या अप्रिय).
 
 
• **Example: **He was the absolute worst kind of **slimy** salesperson.
